platform: Apple M1, macOS/APFS, local release build
baseline: Whole-tree queue reproduced in the same release test binary; no cross-version CLI comparison.
reproduce: RIFTRI_CLONE_BENCH_DIRS=<1|32|128> RIFTRI_CLONE_BENCH_FILES=<8|64|128> cargo test --release -p riftri-storage --lib reports_batched_clone_comparison -- --ignored --nocapture
method: Eight alternating paired rounds per size, 4 KiB regular files plus readme and symlink. Read-only source; owner-writable views. Both paths pay input validation and umask lookup. Full contents, modes, symlink targets, entry names and distinct file inodes checked after timing. No outliers removed. Clone-stage only, not end-to-end creation or process RSS.
assessment: Retained file jobs are bounded to 1024 by deterministic tests. Large fixture p50 improves, medium fixture regresses; variable local timings do not establish general throughput improvement. Keep PR draft pending representative end-to-end and cross-platform throughput evidence.
